data.name: Fasiha
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'fahishah' meaning wisdom, insight, and knowledge. In Islamic tradition, Fasiha is a name given to girls signifying intelligence and understanding.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who is expected to grow up to be a wise and intelligent individual, with a deep understanding of the world around them and the ability to make informed decisions based on knowledge and wisdom

in_arabic.name: فَسيحَ
in_arabic.long_meaning: فَسيحَ: أَسمٌ مُنَقَّحٌ، يَرمي بِالعِزِّ، وَالدَّخولِ الجَديدِ، وَالتَّقىُّمِ. يَلحقُ بِأَسماءِ النَّبِيِّينَ، وَالمُلوكِ، وَالشُيوخِ. وَهُوَ مِنَ اللَّهِ تَعَالى، فَاِستَعمِلوهُ لِصَدرِ أَبناءِ أُمَّتِهِ، وَاِسخِدوهُ لِعَلى أَزواجِهِم، وَاِستَعمِلوهُ في المَعاليِ.

in_urdu.name: فسیحہ

in_urdu.long_meaning: فسیحہ: ایک اچھی نام ہے جس سے لوگ تعلق رکھتے ہیں کہ وہ خوشگوار اور عظیم ہیں۔ یہ نام اللہ تعالیٰ کا نام ہے اور اس میں عظمت اور اچھے اعمال کا تعلق ہے۔ اس نام کی صدر اور معانی کا تعلق ہے۔ اس کا معنی ہے کہ اللہ تعالیٰ سے تعلق رکھنا اور ان کے ہدایت پر عمل کرنا۔

in_hindi.name: फसीहा
in_hindi.meaning: एक अच्छा नाम, जो लोगों को अच्छा और महान लगता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: फसीहा: एक अच्छा नाम है जो लोगों को अच्छा और महान लगता है। यह नाम अल्लाह का नाम है और इसमें महानता और अच्छे कार्यों का संबंध है। इसका अर्थ है अल्लाह से संबंध बनाना और उनके निर्देशों पर कार्य करना।

in_pashto.name: فسيحہ
in_pashto.meaning: یوڼے کا نوم، د ښه نوم، د ښه کا نوم
in_pashto.long_meaning: فسيحہ: یوڼے کا نوم دی، د ښه نوم دی، د ښه کا نوم دی. دې نوم په ښه کښې او عظیم کښې ښوونه کوي. دې نوم په مسلمانو کښې ډېره ښه او معتبر نوم دی، او په دې نوم څخه د لوستونو لپاره ښه نوم دی.

data.cultural_impact: The name Fasiha is heavily rooted in the cultural practices and traditions of the Islamic world. In many Muslim communities, the naming of children holds significant importance and is often done with the hope that the child's name will reflect their desired traits and characteristics. The name Fasiha is an excellent example of this, as it signifies the appreciation and value placed on intelligence, knowledge, and insight. These traits are highly regarded in Islamic culture, with knowledge being considered a gift from Allah and a means of personal growth and enlightenment.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Fasiha holds great significance as it is a reminder of the importance of knowledge and understanding in the path to God. In Islamic belief, knowledge is a means of draw closer to Allah and a critical component of faith. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is reported to have said, "God, his angels, and all of His creatures praise the man who learns a letter from the Book of Allah, and who then teaches it." Thus, the name Fasiha serves as a constant reminder to seek knowledge and understanding not only of the world around us but also of the divine wisdom and guidance found in the Islamic faith.
